meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude writes Python code using Dask to handle datasets larger than RAM: it builds lazy task graphs, then executes them in parallel across cores or machines. It supports DataFrames, arrays, bags for text/JSON, and custom futures.
howto.when_en: Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory, process multiple files in parallel, or distribute workloads across cores or clusters.
